session.question: How does TSignal handle SPs, and what does it predict about their cleavage site and presence on benchmark datasets?
session.answer:
TSignal is a deep transformer-based neural network for signal peptide (SP) prediction that uses BERT language models and dot-product attention to analyze amino acid sequences. It handles SPs by jointly predicting whether a protein contains an SP and where the cleavage site lies between the SP and the mature protein. (dumitrescu2023tsignalatransformer chunk 1)

On common benchmark datasets, TSignal shows competitive accuracy for SP presence prediction and state-of-the-art cleavage site prediction accuracy for most SP types and organism groups. In other words, it is effective both at identifying proteins with SPs and at localizing the SP cleavage site across heterogeneous test sequences. (dumitrescu2023tsignalatransformer chunk 1)
